objective: Characterize the Film Damage Film Burn ring geometry and additive warm RGB response over control value, side, aspect ratio, resolution and alpha association, including transparent-edge compositing and HDR range.

scope.effect: FilmDamageCPUImpl per-pixel Film Burn equation only; grain, dust, scratches, gate weave and flicker are neutralized.
scope.method: Offline deterministic NumPy equation model with fixed diagnostic center choices. It does not reproduce std::mt19937 center selection or execute C++.

comparison.baseline: No burn at value 0 on the same synthetic fixture; arithmetic baseline only, not a quality target.
candidates: fixed left/right centers x=-.08/1.08 and y=.5
straight and premultiplied alpha storage assumptions
comparison.ground_truth: No external ground truth. The zero-burn fixture isolates equation response but does not define acceptable film appearance.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive response only. No aesthetic pass/fail or assumed perceptual threshold. Report channel range, ring footprint and alpha/composite behavior by region and condition.

materials.fixture: Locally generated synthetic translucent ellipse with warm/cool patches, fine checker and white lines, smooth antialiased-style alpha edge and zero RGB outside coverage.
materials.rights: Generated locally by the study script.
materials.identity: Record SHA-256 hashes for source, plan, runner, fixture arrays, metrics and PNG outputs.

conditions.format: Float32 BGRA, logical RGB in [0,1], direct numeric domain without transfer conversion. Burn is added to RGB without clamp; alpha is copied from source.
conditions.equation: nx=x/max(width-1,1), ny=y/max(height-1,1), d=sqrt((nx-cx)^2+(ny-cy)^2), radius=.18+filmBurn*.8, burn=filmBurn*clamp(1-abs(d-radius)/.12,0,1). BGRA additions are B+=.08*burn, G+=.48*burn, R+=1.35*burn.
conditions.centers: Diagnostic fixed center y=.5 and x=-.08 or 1.08. These expose both source branches without claiming actual random draws.
conditions.association: Straight source-over = storedRGB*alpha+background*(1-alpha); premultiplied source-over = storedRGB+background*(1-alpha). Output alpha equals fixture alpha.
conditions.backgrounds: Black, linear numeric gray .18 and white.
metrics: channel minimum/maximum, >1 channel fraction and nonfinite count
per-region paired compositing MAE/RMSE/p95/max over black/gray/white
normalized ring centroid/radius and distance-field support
conditions.display: Direct-clipped RGB8 previews and contact sheets; float32 arrays/statistics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Check equation constants, zero-value identity, monotonic peak response and exact alpha preservation.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Zero burn leaves RGB unchanged; alpha is exact; positive-value outputs match the stated equation within float tolerance.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect full frame and ring/alpha-edge ROIs at 1:1 and enlarged scale on contact sheets; report ring width and overlap with synthetic detail.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic pass/fail; record observable locations and numeric response.

color_and_alpha.method: Measure warm channel additions and composite deltas across alpha regions and three backgrounds under both association assumptions.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual descriptor at product entry point and whether downstream stages clamp, sanitize or reinterpret transparent RGB.

temporal_stability.reason: Study fixes diagnostic centers; runtime random center draws and Evolution/frame behavior are not rendered.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Repeat normalized-coordinate equation at square and 2:1 aspect ratios and two 2:1 resolutions.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Application route, preview/final scaling, actual backend and app output.

performance.reason: No product timing or memory profiling.

execution.backend: Python 3 and NumPy; local synthetic fixtures only; no app operation.
execution.threshold_policy: Descriptive only; no unsupported perceptual tolerance is invented.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed equation parameters, fixture construction and center choices; record dependency versions and artifact checksums.
